hypothesis: A long-only Donchian close breakout may have better net expectancy when the signal bar is in a bullish, low-volatility context than the same breakout rule without the context filter.

context.trend: EMA50 > EMA200, both computed from completed 4h closes
context.thresholdFit: q33 computed only from training observations; frozen for validation and test
context.unknownHandling: No signal if indicator warm-up or context inputs are unavailable
context.shockExclusion: abs(log(close[t]/close[t-1])) <= training-period q99 of absolute 4h log returns; q99 fitted on train only and frozen

entry.overlap: one position at a time; ignore signals while position is open

exit.timeStop: close of the 12th bar after entry
exit.intrabarConflict: adverse-first: if stop and target both touch in one bar, count stop first
exit.gapRules: stop gaps fill at bar open; target gaps fill at target price
exit.splitBoundary: entry and exit must both fall within the same split; purge boundary-overlapping trades

costs.funding: Apply each historical USDⓈ-M funding settlement crossed while position is open. Use settlement markPrice * fundingRate per unit where markPrice is present; if missing, use the matching 4h candle open at fundingTime (nearest openTime within 60 seconds) as an explicitly flagged proxy. Untouched test is not eligible for OOS promotion if any test trade uses a proxy mark.
costs.limitations: 15bp is a proxy, not account-specific or historical order-book calibrated. No maker fills assumed.

sizing.unit: one SOL base unit for R-normalized trade outcomes
sizing.portfolioRisk: not inferred; quote PnL is per one SOL unit

comparisonArms: Same Donchian entry/exit rule without BULL_LOW context filter
Buy-and-hold SOL over untouched test interval, reported separately and not treated as a like-for-like strategy

parameterRobustness.selection: Use the preregistered base (20, 1.5) unless at least 30 validation trades exist; if at least 30, select the highest validation net expectancy, ties resolved by smaller lookback then smaller stop multiple. Do not inspect test results for selection.

splits.purgeEmbargo: 12 bars (48 hours) around split boundaries; only trades fully contained in one split are scored

plannedStatistics: mean net R and per-unit quote PnL
moving-block bootstrap 95% interval for mean net R

dataRequirements.validate: monotonic timestamps, 4h continuity, duplicates, OHLC invariants, positive volume, finite values, closeTime and forming-bar exclusion
dataRequirements.fundingMarkPriceHandling: Exact markPrice preferred; OHLCV 4h open proxy only for missing historical markPrice, with per-trade proxy flag and test-period zero-proxy requirement for OOS evidence.

noTradeRules: signal not confirmed by completed 4h close
